correctness.rationale: At every integer dimension at least two, Dirichlet mixed moments and their derivatives give both means, both variances and covariance; the special d=2 pattern is handled by zero index multiplicity. The iid exponential representation and two-coordinate smooth delta method prove the nondegenerate bivariate Gaussian law. The required exponential moments are finite; centering errors vanish on their respective scales. Independent calculation of finite moments for 118 dimensions and Monte Carlo at four dimensions corroborated but did not substitute for the proof.

It quantifies an unexpectedly high yet nonunit limiting correlation and strictly nonzero residual entropy-coherence uncertainty. Its precise cross-covariance and distinct scales answer a natural joint-typicality question motivated by the referenced coherence literature, without claiming unproved downstream applications.
